caption: The drawing depicts a wooden cabinet consisting of two main sections: an upper and a lower portion. The upper section features two doors in the center, each door adorned with vertical rectangular panels containing small, dark motifs resembling vessels or bottles with stands. Flanking the doors on either side are vertical black columns with decorative turnings. The top of the cabinet is capped with a cornice featuring a subtle carved border. The lower section of the cabinet is broader and features two square drawers, each drawer having a central dark diamond-shaped motif. The entire cabinet is rendered in brown tones with visible wood grain, and the decorative motifs, columns, and some borders are highlighted in a dark black color. The background is a plain off-white or light beige, and no other objects are present in the composition.
title: Guilford Press Cupboard
